name: novel-p0-scale-matrix-live-final
argv: set -euo pipefail; novel_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/novel-p0-scale-live.XXXXXX); novel_base=$(basename "$novel_tmp"); for novel_scale in S1 S3 S5; do novel_a="$novel_tmp/${novel_scale}-a"; novel_b="$novel_tmp/${novel_scale}-b"; npx tsx scripts/create-novel-scale-fixtures.ts --scale "$novel_scale" --output "$novel_a"; npx tsx scripts/validate-novel-scale-fixture.ts "$novel_a"; npx tsx scripts/create-novel-scale-fixtures.ts --scale "$novel_scale" --output "$novel_b"; npx tsx scripts/validate-novel-scale-fixture.ts "$novel_b"; cmp "$novel_a/corpus.md" "$novel_b/corpus.md"; cmp "$novel_a/golden-answers.json" "$novel_b/golden-answers.json"; cmp "$novel_a/manifest.json" "$novel_b/manifest.json"; jq -c "{scale:.scale,profile:.validationProfile,chapters:.chapterCount,characters:.actualCharacters,utf8Bytes:.utf8Bytes,corpusSha256:.corpusSha256,goldenAnswersSha256:.goldenAnswersSha256,logicalFingerprint:.logicalFingerprint,oracleCounts:.oracleCounts}" "$novel_a/manifest.json"; done; novel_trash="/Users/hxx/.Trash/$novel_base"; test ! -e "$novel_trash"; mv "$novel_tmp" "$novel_trash"; printf "%s\n" "{\"cleanup\":\"moved-recoverably-to-user-trash\",\"temporaryBasename\":\"$novel_base\",\"allPairsByteIdentical\":true,\"externalModelCalls\":0}"
